scope: Separate post-registration diagnostic; does not rewrite study design or candidate selection. Interprets two existing root API calls without making further requests.

interpretation.supported: For this one known ALT article, a window including creation but excluding update returned zero articles; a window including update but excluding creation returned that article. The observed behavior is consistent with start/end filtering on updated_at, and inconsistent with a simple created_at-only filter for this example.
not_established: A contractual rule across all articles, sources, dates or API versions.
An immutable archive of the article headline/body/symbols as they existed at the original creation time.
Full coverage of all articles created in any candidate window.
The reason for every possible empty response.
interpretation.coverage_consequence: An article originally created before candidate open and revised after open may be excluded from a fixed preopen query. A local created_at check cannot recover articles the response omitted. Thus an empty response or metadata rejection remains missing/unconfirmed evidence, not proof of no historical catalyst.
interpretation.fractional_bound_note: The created-only response accepted the requested fractional-second end bound for this observation. This differs from the archived generic OpenAPI restriction, but does not establish general accepted precision or exact boundary normalization.

retained_rules: Keep the frozen fullcandidate query windows and report measured coverage rather than expanding/reselecting the sample silently.
Use created_at and updated_at checks as conservative metadata diagnostics, not proof of historical headline availability.
Primary issuer/SEC evidence and precise first-publication time are required for an event-confirmed classification.
